item.title: Pennsbury stifles Downingtown West for berth in district final
item.description: DOWNINGTOWN — Early on in Wednesday’s District 1 6A girls basketball semifinal, it was obvious that defense would rule the evening, it was just a question of which one would dominate. Seventh-seeded Pennsbury answered the question emphatically, holding No. 3 Downingtown West without a field goal for more than a quarter-and-a-half to pull away for a convincing 43-19 at Wagner Gymnasium. item.title: Flyers fight back but fall to Capitals in return from Olympic break
item.description: Down to the Washington Capitals after two periods, the Flyers rallied for a tie the game 29 seconds into the third, but a Trevor van Riemsdyk goal led to a 3-1 Caps win.

item.title: Flyers: Silver doesn’t tarnish Travis Sanheim’s Olympic experience
item.description: While Team Canada's loss in the gold-medal game at the Olympics was disappointing, Flyers defenseman Travis Sanheim won't soon forget the two-week tournament and silver medal.
